circuit_breakers._absolute_floor_pct_removed_note: 2026-10-07 Phase 4: the 25% equity-floor kill-switch now reads config/capital.json account.stop_all_trading_if_equity_falls_below (src/risk/floor_config.py) instead of this key, so CRM and the Supervisor can't silently drift from capital.json. Edit capital.json instead.

position_sizing._max_adv_participation_note: Intraday qty <= this % of the stock's 20-day average daily volume. Above ~1% your own order moves the price and the stop fills far worse than planned. Rarely binds at today's ticket sizes; it matters as capital grows.

portfolio_risk._note: 2026-09-22: intraday open risk (stop-to-fill, losing side only, per paper/live mode) may not exceed 0.40% of total capital = 4,000 on 10L, the same as the daily loss limit, so open intraday risk can never exceed what the day is allowed to lose. On 2026-09-22 three correlated shorts were open with ~4,110 at risk (the third would now be blocked). max_open_risk_pct (portfolio-wide, incl. real-money swing) deliberately left unset.

backtest_override._note: CRM G6 gate (src/risk/crm.py:_g6_strategy_health). When a strategy's periodic off-market backtest (src/orchestrator.py:_backtest_loop, startup + nightly 22:00 IST) fails, a live signal is not fully blocked — it may still trade if its own setup_quality_score (0-100) clears min_quality_score, sized down by size_mult.
backtest_override.min_quality_score_range: 0-100; higher = stricter. Must exceed the normal per-strategy min_quality_score (65/70) in config/strategies_registry.json to actually raise the bar for a backtest-failing strategy.
